selection: Among candidates passing all development gates, maximize mean in-cone tonal correct rate; fixed candidate order breaks ties. If none pass, freeze highest-scoring candidate only for exploratory heldout diagnosis, not acceptance. No tuning after any results.
gate_semantics: Pooled per-condition rates. Tonal >= PHAT-2pp each in-cone condition; average band gain >=75% of unprotected beta075 gain (negative reference gains require nonnegative guard gain); pink/narrow-target each >= unprotected-2pp. Each absent and outside-active false rate <= each of PHAT and beta075 +0.5pp. No p-value or hardware claim.
frozen: 5/12 capture,30deg cone, original LS acceptance and pair mask; fallback top3 cross-amplitude median>=0.35; cap relative retained amplitude^0.25 at1.5x median
source_control: narrow_target is legitimate 800-1400Hz band-limited source plus band noise RMS0.1; all other target probes original broadband. Tonal noises independent per-mic random phase sine +0.05 white, total RMS1. Same target/RIR per trial across methods.
